feed.title: Garnet releases
feed.subtitle: Published GitHub releases for Island-Dev-Crew/garnet. Real releases only.

entry.title: Garnet v0.8.2
entry.summary: v0.8.2 — CLI binaries for Linux x86_64 and ARM64 (.deb, .rpm, tarballs; glibc 2.39+), macOS Apple-Silicon and Intel tarballs and a Windows x86_64 zip, plus a CycloneDX SBOM, host-native VSIX assets, SHA256SUMS and its GPG signature SHA256SUMS.asc. The binaries are not code-signed. The strict network policy judges IPv4 carried inside IPv6. Research-grade prototype, not production-complete.

entry.title: Garnet v0.8.1
entry.summary: v0.8.1 — CLI binaries for Linux x86_64 (.deb, .rpm) and macOS Apple-Silicon and Intel tarballs, plus a CycloneDX SBOM, SHA256SUMS and its GPG signature SHA256SUMS.asc, the first signed checksums. The binaries are not code-signed. Carries the trust-kernel work (@caps and @max_depth traps on both backends). Research-grade prototype, not production-complete.

entry.title: Garnet v0.8.0
entry.summary: v0.8.0 — the tag for the S30-S80 run. Its assets are the garnet-0.5.0 build (garnet-0.5.0-* tarballs, garnet_0.5.0-1_amd64.deb and the .rpm), not a 0.8.0 build, with SHA256SUMS unsigned and VSIX assets from 0.5.0 to 0.7.0. Research-grade prototype, not production-complete.

entry.title: Garnet v0.5.0
entry.summary: v0.5.0 — Linux .deb/.rpm packages, macOS Apple-Silicon and Intel CLI tarballs, host-native VSIX release assets, and SHA256SUMS. Research-grade prototype, not production-complete; Apple notarization, Windows MSI, Marketplace/OpenVSX, and Windows/Linux Studio runtime proof remain separate gates.

entry.title: Garnet v0.4.2
entry.summary: v0.4.2 — checksum-verified macOS Apple-Silicon tarball, Linux .deb/.rpm, and SHA256SUMS. The universal installer pulls and verifies it end to end. Research-grade prototype, not production-complete.
